testcase.system-out: Scenario: loft-12 Create a solid Loft with a center-line sketch ✔ Given a disposable copy of the native fixture "fixtures/cad/loft/circles-center-line.opd" is open ✔ And the two circular sections and straight sketch between their centers are visible ✔ When both circular profiles are selected in Loft and Center Line mode is chosen ✔ Then the dialog requests a center-line sketch and OK is disabled ✔ When the Center Line selector is activated and Sketch3 is shown as the selected center line ✔ Then a solid preview appears and OK is enabled ✔ When OK is clicked ✔ Then Loft1 and Solid Bodies(1) appear in the browser
